summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Watchlist not persisting across login  ### What I found from a read-only audit I traced the full chain before proposing anything: `server.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `schema.ts` → `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `useAuth.tsx` → `App.tsx`, plus the session/cookie logic in `db/auth.ts`.  Contrary to the ticket's working theory, I did **not** find an obvious wiring bug in the code as it stands today: - The watchlist router has its own auth middleware (`handlers.ts:13-21`) that requires a valid `arca_session` cookie o
